name: Ground elevation
official_threshold: Below 20 m for open-cycle cooling, below 50 m for closed-cycle.
note: Terrain height at the cell centre from the national 25 m model resampled to 100 m.

name: Distance to 10 m sea depth
official_threshold: Within 2 km of the shoreline (open cycle) or 5 km (closed cycle).
note: Needs bathymetry; no depth dataset is pinned in this project.

name: Distance to the sea (cooling water)
official_threshold: Within 3 km (open cycle) or 10 km (closed cycle) of a suitable water body.
note: The sea is the only suitable water body (no Estonian river has the flow). Straight-line distance to the ETAK sea polygons.

name: Shore building-ban zone
official_threshold: Legal zone, 100 m on the mainland sea coast and 200 m on sea islands, wider on some shores.
note: Drawn as a fixed distance from the sea; the legal zone varies by shore type and does not bind a state special plan. Narrower than one grid cell, so read it as indicative.

name: Very dense population
name_et: Jätta eelistatavatest aladest välja väga tiheda rahvastikuga alad
official_threshold: 200 residents per km² (the equivalent of US NRC RG 4.7's 500 per square mile). Proposed for ranking only.
note: Residents of the 1 km statistical grid cell that holds the cell centre.

name: Residents within 5 km
official_threshold: The REP names "population and sensitive objects in the urgent protective action area" a priority comparison criterion; it sets no radius or count.
note: Sum of the 1 km grid cells whose centre lies within 5 km. Radius and counts are this project's assumption.

name: Densely built-up settlement
official_threshold: A comparison criterion of the REP ("Tiheasustusala"); no distance.
note: Official densely populated areas (tiheasustusalad).

name: Distance to towns of 10,000 or more
official_threshold: Within 20 or 50 km of a town of at least 10,000 residents (workforce and services).
note: Dropped from the REP screening table; not reproduced.

name: Hazardous establishments
official_threshold: Each establishment's own danger zone (30 m to about 800 m in the planning area).
note: Distance to category A and B establishments of the Rescue Board register. 5 km is IAEA SSG-35's example screening distance for flammable, toxic or explosive storage, not an Estonian rule.

name: Dense tanker traffic
official_threshold: None; the experts found it does not affect the choice of site.
note: Not reproduced.

name: State and military aerodromes
name_et: Lennujaama lähenemis ja õhkutõusu alad, KV radarid
official_threshold: 15 km buffer around approach and take-off areas and Defence Forces radars.
note: Distance to the reference point of the seven state aerodromes and Ämari air base. Radar positions are not public.

name: Other airfields in use
official_threshold: Traffic-based IAEA SSG-35 formula for large airports; 10 km for small airports.
note: Distance to private paved and grass airfields. Former and unused airfields are left out.

name: Aerodrome protection zones and limitation surfaces
official_threshold: The legal zones.
note: No open nationwide layer of the limitation surfaces was found. The two airfield criteria above are the nearest stand-in and are not exclusions.

name: Gas transmission pipelines
official_threshold: The legal protection zones (tens of metres).
note: Distance to category D (transmission) gas installations in the restrictions register. The 1 km distance is this project's assumption for a screening grid.

name: Slope stability
official_threshold: Slopes steeper than 10° (2023 analysis).
note: Needs the 1 to 10 m terrain model; the 100 m model used here cannot show such slopes.

name: Soil liquefaction
official_threshold: Saturated sand layer thicker than 8 m (2023 analysis).
note: Needs borehole and Quaternary thickness data.

name: Karst
official_threshold: Karst layer of the 1:50 000 geological map.
note: Karst areas of the nature register (EELIS) and karst fields of the hydrogeological map. Point karst forms are not gridded.

name: Weak ground (mires and peat)
official_threshold: Peat, mud and clay areas (2023 analysis).
note: Mires of the national mire inventory only; mud and clay areas are not included.

name: Buried valleys
official_threshold: None.
note: Not reproduced.

name: Mineral deposits and surface mining
name_et: Maavarade pealmaa kaevandamine (aktiivsed, taotletavad, korrastatud alad)
official_threshold: None.
note: Registered deposits and active mining claims.

name: Underground mining
name_et: Maavarade allmaa kaevandamine (aktiivsed ja mahajäetud kaevandused)
official_threshold: Active and abandoned underground mines.
note: Undermined oil-shale and phosphorite areas and underground mining claims.

name: Distance from bedrock faults
official_threshold: 5 km from an active fault (REP, from the site centre); the 2023 analysis buffered every known fault by 5 km. IAEA SSG-35 quotes 8 km as an example.
note: No Estonian fault is proven active. As in the 2023 screening, every mapped bedrock fault of the 1:400 000 geological map is buffered, so this is conservative.

name: Distance from basement faults
official_threshold: The 2023 analysis names "confirmed and inferred basement faults cutting sedimentary rock".
note: Faults of the crystalline basement map (1:400 000). Whether they cut the sedimentary cover is not recorded, so they are offered separately.

name: Flood-prone areas
official_threshold: 1-in-1000-year flood. Exclusionary in 2023, a consideration in the REP.
note: Flood risk areas of the 2024 assessment and the register's flood-hazard areas. These cover known risk areas, not the full 1-in-1000-year extent.

name: Erosion
official_threshold: Eroding coasts and eroded soils (2023 analysis).
note: Not reproduced.

name: Heritage monuments and their protection zones
official_threshold: The monuments and their legal zones.
note: Immovable monuments, heritage conservation areas and their protection zones from the national register.

name: Protected areas
official_threshold: Rows 22 to 25 of the screening table (strict reserves, national parks, nature and landscape protection areas).
note: All protected areas (kaitsealad) of the nature register, including protected parks and stands.

name: Natura 2000 areas
official_threshold: Bird and habitat areas.
note: Land cells only; cooling-water effects on marine Natura areas are not assessed.

name: Limited-conservation areas
official_threshold: A consideration in 2023; an exclusion layer of the REP's public map.
note: Hoiualad of the nature register.

name: Protected single objects and their zones
official_threshold: The objects and their legal zones.
note: Zones are mostly 50 m in radius, smaller than a grid cell; read as indicative.

name: Woodland key habitats
name_et: Vääriselupaigad riigimaal ja lepingutega vääriselupaigad eramaal
official_threshold: Key habitats on state land and contracted ones on private land.
note: All registered key habitats; the register does not give land ownership, so uncontracted habitats on private land are included too.

name: Species protection sites
official_threshold: The sites.
note: The layer is served only to authorised users.

name: Green network
official_threshold: None.
note: Green network areas of the comprehensive plans (polygons only).

name: Protected plants, fungi and lichens
name_et: Kaitsealuste taimede, seente ja samblike leiukohad (I–III kat.)
official_threshold: 60 m buffer on point records.
note: Category I and II records are not public.

name: Category II and III animals
name_et: II ja III kaitsekategooria loomaliikide leiukohad
official_threshold: None.
note: Records are not public.

name: Category I animals
official_threshold: None.
note: Records are not public.

name: Salmon rivers
official_threshold: Exclusionary in 2023, a consideration in the REP.
note: Not reproduced.

name: Unprotected groundwater
official_threshold: Not a row of the official tables; groundwater was a main concern in the 2026 public feedback.
note: Areas mapped as having unprotected groundwater.

name: 330 kV grid within reach
official_threshold: Two to three 330 kV connections to substations; distance bands 1, 10 and 100 km.
note: Distance to the nearest 330 kV line of the topographic database, not to a substation.

name: Main road within reach
official_threshold: Main road within 5 km (10 km in 2023).
note: Distance to the nearest state main road (põhimaantee).

name: Railway within reach
official_threshold: 20 km. The REP notes it is not a realistic requirement.
note: Distance to the nearest broad-gauge track.

name: Port within reach
official_threshold: Cargo port within 20 km.
note: Distance to the nearest registered port of class "sadam"; the layer does not separate cargo ports from passenger and fishing ports.

name: Infrastructure restriction zones
official_threshold: The legal zones, including water-intake sanitary protection zones.
note: Narrow zones that matter at site scale, not on a screening grid.

name: Distance from dwellings
official_threshold: Existing dwellings and their plots are excluded; 350 m from dwellings to the reactor; 100 m around residential and public buildings.
note: Distance from the cell centre to the nearest residential building footprint. Public buildings and plot boundaries are not included.

name: Defence sites and their restriction zones
official_threshold: Regulation no. 16 of the Minister of Defence.
note: Public defence structures, training areas and their restriction zones. Non-public security criteria removed the three Lüganuse sites in October 2026 and cannot be reproduced.

name: Ministry of Defence consideration areas
official_threshold: Not public.
note: Not public.

name: Land value
official_threshold: None.
note: Not reproduced.

name: Existing land use
official_threshold: None.
note: Not reproduced.

name: One further land-use row
official_threshold: Unknown.
note: The row's name could not be read from the published PDF.

name: Lakes and reservoirs
official_threshold: Water bodies.
note: Lakes and reservoirs of the nature register.

name: Distance from the land border
name_et: Kaugus maismaa riigipiirist 5 km ja piiriveekogud
official_threshold: 5 km from the land border and border water bodies.
note: Distance to the state border line of the restrictions register (land, lake and river border with Russia and Latvia).

name: Emergency plan cannot be implemented
official_threshold: Expert assessment.
note: An assessment, not a map layer. "Residents within 5 km" is offered as a rough indicator.

name: Enough contiguous land
official_threshold: 95 ha for two BWRX-300 units with their buffer.
note: Remaining cells joined edge to edge must add up to the area. Applied after every other selected criterion.
